name: servicecatalog-appregistry
description: Amazon Web Services Service Catalog AppRegistry enables organizations to understand the application context of their Amazon Web Services resources.

subcommands.name: associate-attribute-group
subcommands.description: Associates an attribute group with an application to augment the application's metadata with the group's attributes.

subcommands.name: associate-resource
subcommands.description: Associates a resource with an application.

subcommands.name: create-application
subcommands.description: Creates a new application that is the top-level node in a hierarchy of related cloud resource abstractions.

subcommands.name: create-attribute-group
subcommands.description: Creates a new attribute group as a container for user-defined attributes.

subcommands.name: delete-application
subcommands.description: Deletes an application that is specified either by its application ID, name, or ARN.

subcommands.name: delete-attribute-group
subcommands.description: Deletes an attribute group, specified either by its attribute group ID, name, or ARN.

subcommands.name: disassociate-attribute-group
subcommands.description: Disassociates an attribute group from an application to remove the extra attributes contained in the attribute group from the application's metadata.

subcommands.name: disassociate-resource
subcommands.description: Disassociates a resource from application.

subcommands.name: get-application
subcommands.description: Retrieves metadata information about one of your applications.

subcommands.name: get-associated-resource
subcommands.description: Gets the resource associated with the application.

subcommands.name: get-attribute-group
subcommands.description: Retrieves an attribute group by its ARN, ID, or name.

subcommands.name: get-configuration
subcommands.description: Retrieves a TagKey configuration from an account.

subcommands.name: list-applications
subcommands.description: Retrieves a list of all of your applications.

subcommands.name: list-associated-attribute-groups
subcommands.description: Lists all attribute groups that are associated with specified application.

subcommands.name: list-associated-resources
subcommands.description: Lists all of the resources that are associated with the specified application.

subcommands.name: list-attribute-groups
subcommands.description: Lists all attribute groups which you have access to.

subcommands.name: list-attribute-groups-for-application
subcommands.description: Lists the details of all attribute groups associated with a specific application.

subcommands.name: list-tags-for-resource
subcommands.description: Lists all of the tags on the resource.

subcommands.name: put-configuration
subcommands.description: Associates a TagKey configuration to an account.

subcommands.name: sync-resource
subcommands.description: Syncs the resource with current AppRegistry records.

subcommands.name: tag-resource
subcommands.description: Assigns one or more tags (key-value pairs) to the specified resource.

subcommands.name: untag-resource
subcommands.description: Removes tags from a resource.

subcommands.name: update-application
subcommands.description: Updates an existing application with new attributes.

subcommands.name: update-attribute-group
subcommands.description: Updates an existing attribute group with new details.
